title: Martha Holidays
description:
S1 E3 — Martha's Thanksgiving Pies
Every year, Martha makes pies to give to everyone working on the farm during the holiday, and this year she's sharing three of her delicious recipes.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S3 E1 — Thanksgiving With a Southern Twist
Martha invites her long-time friend and former catering partner, Sara Foster to Bedford to cook up a Southern-style Thanksgiving meal.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S3 E2 — Thanksgiving Pies
Joanne Chang from Flour Bakery in Boston shows Martha how she makes a chocolate cream pie and a pear and cranberry crostata; Martha makes her special five-spice pumpkin pie with phyllo crust.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E6 — Pies
Peach crumble pie; key lime pie baked in a Graham cracker crust; coconut cream pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E1 — Citrus
Orange chiffon cake; Shaker lemon pie; lime squares with pistachio Graham cracker crust; upside-down cake made with three kinds of citrus.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E2 — Northeast
Cranberry tart with currant jelly and cognac; mini chocolate whoopie pies; New York crumb cake; babka.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

Pumpkin pecan pie; cheesecake swirled with pumpkin; pumpkin bread; deep dish pumpkin pie.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E6 — How to Make Croissants and Sourdough Bread
Martha journeys through her local area in search of the ultimate fresh-baked croissants and sourdough bread; learning about homemade bread and pastries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

From cranberry sauce to buttery rolls to incredible chocolates, Martha is shaping everything this holiday into a turkey; it all comes together on a beautifully festive dining table.

Martha makes Thanksgiving turkeys three ways; she goes step-by-step through her roast turkey stuffed with classic stuffing, a herb-roasted spatchcocked bird and a deep-fried, herb-rubbed turkey.
